Tate McRae's "Housewife" is No. 1 on the Spotify global weekly chart for a second week: 48.2M streams for the week of Oct 29, 2026, up 9.1M on its first week (39.1M).

The song came out Oct 15 and leads the No. 2 song, KAROL G's "BbY WOW", by 12.7M streams. On the Billboard Hot 100 it debuted at No. 2.

Is "Housewife" the song of the year? 👇

Data: Spotify global weekly chart via kworb · weeks of Oct 22 and Oct 29, 2026; Billboard Hot 100
